title: fix(console): on a phone, a page the assistant opens closes its sheet
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg8JRuu4biowMGgDVcNVcsSp)_
Fixes #37556
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：在手机上用应用内 AI，点回答下方的引用后，AI 对话面板自动收起，直接看到被标出的那一段；再打开 AI 面板，还是原来的对话。电脑上面板照旧留在页面旁边。
- 为什么做：记录 AI 问询专题里引用条的跟进，原先手机上点引用像没反应，要手动关面板才看得到。
- 出错会怎样：手机上点 AI 里的链接后面板该收不收或不该收时收起；对话和数据不受影响，撤回本次合并即可恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/useConsoleChatDock.tsx`: on a phone (the drawer is a bottom sheet over the page), the host now collapses the sheet when the location changes by a navigation that leaves the page (path + search differ), or by a PUSH onto the same page (a second click on the same citation chip, which carries fresh section state to the same URL). A REPLACE that keeps the page (the host's own handoff hand-over) leaves the sheet open. Rail (desktop) and full-window rule unchanged. This mirrors the existing rule beside it that drops full-window on leaving the page.
- The rule lives in the host, not at the chip: every navigation the chat makes on a phone (citation chip, `open_record`, list link, open-form) now reveals the page, and the chip's click path (`AiChatPage.tsx`, under PR #37539) is not touched.
- The conversation is kept: collapsing only closes the sheet; the dock target is untouched, so reopening shows the same thread.
- Changeset `.changeset/37556-phone-dock-closes-on-citation.md` (patch, `@object-ui/app-shell`).

Read first: `useConsoleChatDock.tsx`, the new effect under the full-window one.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/useConsoleChatDock.phoneCollapseOnNavigate-37556.test.tsx` (4), the real host, `useChatDockState` and router, with stand-in sheet/rail: phone chip click (PUSH to the cited record) closes the sheet, and reopening it by the robot (no target) shows the same conversation; a re-click of the same chip URL closes the reopened sheet; a same-page REPLACE leaves it open; CONTROL: at desktop width the rail stays open after the same chip click.
- Ablation (collapse call replaced by a no-op): 2 failed, 2 passed (the two phone-click cases red; the REPLACE case and desktop control stay green); restored 4/4.

## Acceptance notes

- Acceptance 1 (test): above.
- Acceptance 2 (booted-console phone check): see Verification.

## Verification

- Local: the new test 4/4; `@object-ui/app-shell` whole suite, type-check and the derived gates: see the report comment on the card.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/useConsoleChatDock.phoneCollapseOnNavigate-37556.test.tsx`, expected 4 passed.
